body:
The counters section now has one three-dot menu below the list containing Add counter and Archived. Adding focuses the configuration name; Archived retains its toggle state. The shared menu uses the available space above, below or beside the trigger on short screens. Existing counter drafts, history and writes are preserved.

Final verification: full gate passes 251 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; four Chromium and three WebKit suites pass. Both engines pass 24 geometry cases covering empty/populated lists, first/last section and 320–1440px plus landscape. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual app: trusted HTTPS at https://100.122.250.14:47832 serves all 33 matching build assets; all 37 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-counter-actions-menu.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Move counter actions into a compact menu
